WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS overall_total,
         AVG(1.0 * articount / NULLIF(SUM(articount) OVER (), 0)) AS avg_share
  FROM scanfeatures
), units AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         articount,
         1.0 * articount / NULLIF((SELECT overall_total FROM totals), 0) AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       articount AS artifact_count,
       share,
       share - (SELECT avg_share FROM totals) AS share_minus_average
FROM units
WHERE (SELECT overall_total FROM totals) IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT avg_share FROM totals) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
